import struct
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

class ZeroCopyPacketParser:
    """Zero-allocation packet parser utilizing memoryviews and struct unpacking."""
    
    HEADER_FORMAT = "!IB36s"  # Magic (4B), Type (1B), UUID/ID (36B)
    HEADER_SIZE = struct.calcsize(HEADER_FORMAT)

    @staticmethod
    def parse_header(buffer: memoryview) -> Tuple[int, int, str, memoryview]:
        """Parses packet header from memoryview without byte string allocation."""
        if len(buffer) < ZeroCopyPacketParser.HEADER_SIZE:
            raise ValueError(f"Buffer too small for header: {len(buffer)} < {ZeroCopyPacketParser.HEADER_SIZE}")
        
        header_view = buffer[:ZeroCopyPacketParser.HEADER_SIZE]
        magic, msg_type, raw_id = struct.unpack(ZeroCopyPacketParser.HEADER_FORMAT, header_view)
        
        msg_id = raw_id.rstrip(b'\x00').decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        payload_view = buffer[ZeroCopyPacketParser.HEADER_SIZE:]
        return magic, msg_type, msg_id, payload_view

    @staticmethod
    def serialize_header(magic: int, msg_type: int, msg_id: str, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
        """Serializes message header and payload into wire format."""
        padded_id = msg_id.encode('utf-8').ljust(36, b'\x00')[:36]
        header = struct.pack(ZeroCopyPacketParser.HEADER_FORMAT, magic, msg_type, padded_id)
        return header + payload

import asyncio
import logging
from typing import Optional, Tuple
from gossipmesh.p2p.parser import ZeroCopyPacketParser

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class TransportSocketReader:
    """Low-level transport socket reader with zero-allocation memoryview parsing pipelines."""

    def __init__(self, reader: asyncio.StreamReader, expected_magic: int = 0x474D4553) -> None:
        self.reader = reader
        self.expected_magic = expected_magic

    async def read_packet(self) -> Optional[Tuple[int, str, memoryview]]:
        """Reads a full gossip packet from the stream and returns header metadata and memoryview payload."""
        header_data = await self.reader.readexactly(ZeroCopyPacketParser.HEADER_SIZE)
        if not header_data:
            return None
        
        header_view = memoryview(header_data)
        magic, msg_type, msg_id, _ = ZeroCopyPacketParser.parse_header(header_view)
        
        if magic != self.expected_magic:
            logger.warning(f"Invalid packet magic received: {hex(magic)}")
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid packet magic: {hex(magic)}")

        # For variable length payload, read length prefix or remainder if applicable
        # Here we assume remainder of buffer or standard framed chunks
        return msg_type, msg_id, header_view

import unittest
import asyncio
import struct
from gossipmesh.p2p.parser import ZeroCopyPacketParser
from gossipmesh.p2p.transport import TransportSocketReader

class TestZeroCopyParserAndTransport(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_parser_serialization_and_deserialization(self):
        magic = 0x474D4553
        msg_type = 1
        msg_id = "test-msg-uuid-12345678901234567890"
        payload = b"hello gossipmesh zero copy"

        wire_data = ZeroCopyPacketParser.serialize_header(magic, msg_type, msg_id, payload)
        buf = memoryview(wire_data)

        parsed_magic, parsed_type, parsed_id, parsed_payload = ZeroCopyPacketParser.parse_header(buf)

        self.assertEqual(parsed_magic, magic)
        self.assertEqual(parsed_type, msg_type)
        self.assertTrue(parsed_id.startswith("test-msg-uuid"))
        self.assertEqual(bytes(parsed_payload), payload)

    def test_parser_buffer_too_small(self):
        buf = memoryview(b"short")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ZeroCopyPacketParser.parse_header(buf)

    def test_transport_socket_reader_valid_packet(self):
        magic = 0x474D4553
        msg_type = 2
        msg_id = "node-uuid-987654321098765432109876"
        payload = b"transport test payload"
        wire_data = ZeroCopyPacketParser.serialize_header(magic, msg_type, msg_id, payload)

        async def run_test():
            reader = asyncio.StreamReader()
            reader.feed_data(wire_data)
            reader.feed_eof()

            transport_reader = TransportSocketReader(reader, expected_magic=magic)
            res = await transport_reader.read_packet()
            self.assertIsNotNone(res)
            t_type, t_id, t_view = res
            self.assertEqual(t_type, msg_type)
            self.assertTrue(t_id.startswith("node-uuid"))

        asyncio.run(run_test())

    def test_transport_socket_reader_invalid_magic(self):
        magic = 0xBADDEAD
        msg_type = 1
        msg_id = "bad-magic-uuid-123456789012345678"
        wire_data = ZeroCopyPacketParser.serialize_header(magic, msg_type, msg_id, b"")

        async def run_test():
            reader = asyncio.StreamReader()
            reader.feed_data(wire_data)
            reader.feed_eof()

            transport_reader = TransportSocketReader(reader, expected_magic=0x474D4553)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                await transport_reader.read_packet()

        asyncio.run(run_test())

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
